hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Wellhead choke (adjustable)
function: The adjustable choke on the production wing that sets the flow rate and takes the pressure drop from tubing pressure to flowline pressure.

tabs.overview: A needle and seat or a cage type; erosion-resistant trim; the bean size sets the rate and is read in 64ths.
tabs.engineering: Sized per the flowline and separator pressures.
tabs.safety: Erosion; flowline pressure rises if the choke fails open.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
